title: 第1152章 斗第1151章 杀老头子
content_zh:
火光之中一道黑影爆射而出狠狠的撞击在地面上滚了数百丈这才停下
此人全身焦黑四肢早已没了身躯都被炸去了一半，脸上的血肉全无骨骼破碎凄惨至极
”飞龙师兄”
上官凝玉神识一探随后惊喜道
元婴修士在肉体都没有败亡的情况下元婴便很难枯萎
但以现在的情况来看飞龙也是重伤再战不能
“咳咳，这波应该赚了”
飞龙咳嗽两声吐出两口黑烟，嘴角渗出一滩黑血
元婴修士只是恢复能力强大肉身被毁后痛楚是一样的甚至加倍
飞龙早就知道宇文波很强尤其是他的神通【养精蓄锐】可打破神通叠加上限
配上【伏龙波】增强各项进攻属性、【明王身】增强肉身防御属性等同于越打他就越强，所以要战胜他必须趁早
当初在紫金派与杨天对打都能稳稳地占据上风，纸面战力更是飞龙的几倍
在这般情况下飞龙想要正常击败他，立马取胜，几乎不可能
所以必须要借助外力灭仙雷便是极好的杀敌手段
它只需投掷出去便可爆发出远超一般符箓的爆发伤害
此宝唯一的缺点就是命中率太低，比符箓还要低，没有任何的追踪功能
它的强度只与使用者能否在敌人身前引爆为基准
所以在上次大败过后飞龙便想到了制作一件可以隐蔽灭仙雷的宝物
左思右想之下便制作出了这件灭仙战甲
能够引爆灭仙雷的只能是修士的独特法力，哪怕正常刀劈斧砍拿火去烧，也不会引爆灭仙雷

所以它本身是极为稳定的宝物，而威力也是按剂量来算的，天生便是和堆砌伤害
“你这蠢货”
只是不等飞龙高兴，火光熄灭后，一道身影矗立半空
那是一个仅剩骨架之人，他的血肉正在快速的恢复，金躯玉髓粉红血肉正如麻绳编织一般重新生长
“你们不会我的明王身是单纯看受伤多少次吧”
宇文波大笑着说道
“咳咳，这都没死吗？老头子，看来是天要亡你啊”
飞龙惨笑一声，头一歪，再扛不住晕厥了过去
“呵呵，去死吧”
苏老强一个纵步落下便要给飞龙致命一击
“嗖！
content_en:
A black shadow shot out from the fire and hit hard, rolling hundreds of feet on the ground before stopping.
This man's body was charred black, his limbs had long been lost, half of his body had been blown off, and his face was completely boneless and miserable.
"Senior Brother Feilong"
Shangguan Ningyu took a look and said in surprise:
When the Yuanying monk's body is not destroyed, it is difficult for the Yuanying to wither.
But judging from the current situation, Feilong is also seriously injured and cannot fight anymore.
"Ahem, I should make a profit this time."
Feilong coughed twice and spit out two puffs of black smoke, and a pool of black blood oozed from the corner of his mouth.
Nascent Soul monks only have powerful recovery abilities. After the physical body is destroyed, the pain will be the same or even doubled.
Feilong has long known that Yuwenbo is very strong, especially his magical power [Recharge Energy] which can break the upper limit of superposition of magical powers.
Coupled with [Fu Longbo] to enhance various offensive attributes and [Ming Wang Shen] to enhance physical defense attributes, it is equivalent to the more you fight him, the stronger he will become, so you must defeat him as early as possible.
Back then, he could firmly gain the upper hand in the Zijin Sect's fight with Yang Tian, and his on-paper combat power was several times that of Feilong.
Under such circumstances, it would be almost impossible for Feilong to defeat him normally and win immediately.
Therefore, it is necessary to use external force to destroy the immortal. Thunder is an excellent means of killing enemies.
It only needs to be thrown to cause a burst of damage that far exceeds that of ordinary talismans.
The only drawback of this treasure is that the hit rate is too low, even lower than the talisman, and it does not have any tracking function.
Its strength is only based on whether the user can detonate it in front of the enemy.
So after the last defeat, Feilong thought of making a treasure that could conceal the Immortal-Destroying Thunder.
After thinking about it, I made this immortal-killing armor.
The only thing that can detonate the Immortal Extinguishing Thunder is the monk's unique magic power. Even if it is chopped with a knife and ax normally and burned with fire, it will not detonate the Immortal Extinguishing Thunder.
Therefore, it is an extremely stable treasure, and its power is calculated based on dosage. It is born to stack damage.
"You idiot"
But before Feilong could be happy, after the fire went out, a figure stood in the air
That was a man with only a skeleton left. His flesh and blood was rapidly recovering. His golden body, chalcedony, and pink flesh were growing back like hemp ropes.
"You don't think my Mingwang body is just based on how many times I've been injured."
Yu Wenbo laughed and said
"Ahem, aren't you dead? Old man, it seems that God is going to kill you."
Feilong laughed miserably, tilted his head, couldn't hold it in any longer and fainted.
"Haha, go to hell"
Su Laoqiang fell down in one vertical step and was about to give Fei Long a fatal blow.
“Whoosh!
